build_model: build a video model from a config object with optional GPU device specification
register_model: register a video model class to the MODEL_REGISTRY for config-based instantiation
convert_syncbn_model: convert batch normalization layers to Apex synchronized batchnorm for distributed training
wrap_distributed_data_parallel: wrap a model with DistributedDataParallel for multi-GPU training with optional FP16 compression
get_registered_model: retrieve a registered model constructor from MODEL_REGISTRY by model name
